This part attempts to round the number 3.14159. 
```{r}
round(3.14159)
```

```{r}
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```


This part attempts to repeat 5 for seven times. 
```{r}
print(rep(5, 7))
```
```{r}
print(rep(x = 5, times = 7))
```

This part attempts to catagorise variables. 
```{r}
x <- "miao"
print(x)
print(class(x))
```

```{r}
y <- 2000+95
print(y)
print(class(y))
```

```{r}
z <- TRUE
print(z)
print(class(z))
```

```{r}
cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

n_before_1 <- 5415
n_before_2 <- 8123

n_after_1 <- 1432
n_after_2 <- 7543
```


```{r}
install.packages("fortunes")
```

```{r}
library(fortunes)
fortune()
```
```{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)

```
```{r}
install.packages("gt")
library(gt)
```

```{r}
# Combining vectors
cell_id <- c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2)
treated <- c(treated_1, treated_2)
n_before <- c(n_before_1, n_before_2)
n_after <- c(n_after_1, n_after_2)
```

```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
the_fourth_pet <- all_my_pets[4]
print(the_fourth_pet)
```

```{r}
x <- c(2, -4, 6, -2)
x * 2
x > 5
sum(x)
abs(x)
```

```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  cell_ID = cell_id,
  treated = treated,
  number_cells_before = n_before,
  number_cells_after = n_after
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```
